newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: First Provincial talks to Northern.
newsitem.headline: First Provincial talks to Northern.

text.p: First Provincial Building Society Ltd said on Friday it had talked recently with Northern Building Society Ltd regarding an amalgamation as part of an ongoing evaluation of further merger opportunities.
First Provincial's chairman, Neal Axelby said discussions had also been held with several other non-bank financial institutions with further amalgamations possible.

The talks followed last week's announcement by First Provincial that it was amalgamating with Sunstate Credit Union to create Queensland's second-biggest building society with estimated total asssets of A$650 million.
First Provincial intended continuing to evaluate further opportunities as they arose, Axelby said.
First Provincial however still regarded the amalgamation with Sunstate as its first priority with both sides working towards completion of due diligence by July 31, Axelby said.
Northern Building Society said in a separate statement that as part of a strategic review it had held talks with a number of Queensland building societies about possible mergers.
Northern chairman Brian Roebig said the company had not discounted having further discussions with First Provincial and other Queensland societies, which he did not name.
Northern shares were 12 cents higher at A$2.87 at the end of Friday morning trade. First Provincial shares gained four cents to A$2.44.
